grammar: phr. 有作用；有影响。常用 make a difference to sb/sth。
collocations: make a difference to the community; make a big difference; make a difference in the world
commonMistake: difference 作名词时前常加 a；表示对某人或某事有影响用介词 to。

example.english: A kind word can make a difference to someone who feels lonely.
example.chinese: 一句友善的话能对感到孤独的人产生影响。

application.prompt: Even a small donation can ___ to the local shelter. A. make a difference B. do a difference
application.solution: A。解析：固定表达是 make a difference，表示“产生影响”。

grammar: n. 参观者；来访者。
collocations: a visitor to the museum; welcome visitors; visitor centre
commonMistake: visitor 是“来访者”，地点前常用介词 to；visit 是动词或名词“参观”。

example.english: The museum gives each visitor a free map.
example.chinese: 博物馆给每位参观者一张免费地图。

application.prompt: Each ___ must show a ticket at the entrance. A. visit B. visitor
application.solution: B。解析：each 后接单数可数名词 visitor，指每位参观者。

grammar: adj. 年纪较大的；上了年纪的。
collocations: elderly people; an elderly neighbour; care for elderly people
commonMistake: elderly 常修饰 people/person；elder 主要用于家庭成员比较年龄，如 elder sister。

example.english: The elderly woman walks in the park every morning.
example.chinese: 这位年长的女士每天早晨在公园散步。

application.prompt: The volunteers helped an ___ man cross the street. A. elderly B. elder than
application.solution: A。解析：名词 man 前用形容词 elderly；elder than 不是规范结构。

grammar: phr. 老人；上了年纪的人。the + 形容词表示一类人，谓语通常用复数。
collocations: care for the elderly; services for the elderly; help the elderly
commonMistake: the elderly 指一群老人，作主语时通常用复数谓语；不要再加复数 -s。

example.english: The elderly in our neighbourhood enjoy free exercise classes.
example.chinese: 我们社区的老人喜欢免费的健身课。

application.prompt: ___ need safe places to meet and exercise. A. The elderly needs B. The elderly need
application.solution: B。解析：the elderly 指一类人，谓语用复数 need。

grammar: n. 组织；团体；机构。英式拼写 organisation。
collocations: a local organization; a non-profit organization; join an organization
commonMistake: organization 是名词，动词为 organize；英式拼写 organisation 也正确。

example.english: She works for an organization that protects wild animals.
example.chinese: 她在一个保护野生动物的组织工作。

application.prompt: The volunteers joined a local ___ that helps families. A. organization B. organize
application.solution: A。解析：形容词 local 后需要名词 organization。

grammar: n. 体育馆；运动场。复数常用 stadiums。
collocations: a football stadium; a crowded stadium; at the stadium
commonMistake: stadium 是可数名词；复数常用 stadiums，避免漏写复数标记。

example.english: Thousands of fans filled the stadium for the final.
example.chinese: 成千上万的球迷涌进体育场观看决赛。

application.prompt: Our city built two new ___ last year. A. stadium B. stadiums
application.solution: B。解析：two 后用复数 stadiums。

examTags: 语法·provide 的双宾语结构
grammar: v. 提供；给予。常用 provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for sb。
collocations: provide food for families; provide sb with information; provide help
commonMistake: 用 provide 时通常说 provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for sb；不要漏掉介词 with/for。

example.english: The charity provides hot meals for people in need.
example.chinese: 这家慈善机构为有需要的人提供热餐。

application.prompt: The school will ___ each student with a notebook. A. provide B. lend to
application.solution: A。解析：固定结构为 provide sb with sth。

grammar: n. （食品或饮料的）金属罐；一罐的量。复数 cans。
collocations: a can of soup; a drinks can; open a can
commonMistake: 本单元的 can 是名词“罐头、金属罐”；情态动词 can 后接动词原形。

example.english: He opened a can of tomato soup for lunch.
example.chinese: 他午餐时打开了一罐番茄汤。

application.prompt: We need a ___ of beans for the soup. A. bowl B. can
application.solution: B。解析：表示一罐豆子用 a can of beans。

grammar: n. 主人；物主。
collocations: the owner of a dog; shop owner; become the owner
commonMistake: 表示“某物的主人”用 the owner of sth；own 可作动词“拥有”或形容词“自己的”。

example.english: The owner of the café gives leftover food to a shelter.
example.chinese: 这家咖啡馆的老板把剩余食物送给收容所。

application.prompt: The ___ of the lost bicycle came to collect it. A. own B. owner
application.solution: B。解析：句中需要表示“主人”的名词 owner。

grammar: n. 笼子；囚笼。
collocations: a bird cage; keep an animal in a cage; open the cage
commonMistake: 表示“在笼子里”用 in a cage；cage 是可数名词，单数前需有限定词。

example.english: The bird flew out when the cage door opened.
example.chinese: 笼门打开时，那只鸟飞了出去。

application.prompt: The rabbit is safe inside its ___. A. cave B. cage
application.solution: B。解析：兔子待在笼子里，用 cage。

grammar: n. 捐赠物；捐赠。
collocations: make a donation; a donation to charity; food donations
commonMistake: donation 是名词；donate 是动词。表示捐款常说 make a donation to...。

example.english: The school made a donation to the animal shelter.
example.chinese: 学校向动物收容所捐了一笔款。

application.prompt: The school made a ___ to the shelter. A. donation B. donate
application.solution: A。解析：make a donation 表示“进行捐赠”；冠词 a 后接名词 donation。

examTags: 熟词多义·庇护所与遮蔽
grammar: n. 庇护所；居所；避难处；v. 遮蔽；庇护。
collocations: an animal shelter; take shelter from the rain; homeless shelter
commonMistake: 表示“躲避雨雪”可说 take shelter from；shelter 也可作动词，表示提供庇护。

example.english: The volunteers built a warm shelter for the stray cats.
example.chinese: 志愿者为流浪猫建了一处温暖的庇护所。

application.prompt: The hikers found ___ from the storm in a small cave. A. sheltering B. shelter
application.solution: B。解析：表示“躲避风暴”用 find shelter from the storm。

grammar: n. 面试官；采访者。
collocations: a job interviewer; answer the interviewer; interview questions
commonMistake: interviewer 是提问的人；interviewee 是接受面试或采访的人。

example.english: The interviewer asked me why I wanted to join the team.
example.chinese: 面试官问我为什么想加入这个团队。

application.prompt: The person who asks questions in an interview is the ___. A. interviewer B. interviewee
application.solution: A。解析：提问的一方是 interviewer，接受提问的是 interviewee。

grammar: n. 青年；青年时期。表示年轻人群体时常作集合名词。
collocations: youth group; in one’s youth; youth work
commonMistake: youth 可表示“青年时期”或“青年群体”；表示一个年轻人时用 a young person，而非 a youth 在所有语境通用。

example.english: She spent her youth helping at the community centre.
example.chinese: 她在青年时期常在社区中心帮忙。

application.prompt: She joined a ___ group at school. A. youths B. youth
application.solution: B。解析：固定搭配是 youth group；youth 作名词修饰 group 时不用复数。

grammar: n. 养老院；护理院。
collocations: live in a nursing home; visit a nursing home; nursing home residents
commonMistake: nursing home 指提供居住和护理服务的机构；不要按 nursing 单独理解成“护理工作”。

example.english: The students visit a nursing home once a month.
example.chinese: 学生们每月去养老院探访一次。

application.prompt: The volunteers read stories to older people at a ___. A. nursing home B. train station
application.solution: A。解析：为年长者提供居住和护理的地方是 nursing home。

grammar: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的。
collocations: be active in a club; take an active part; stay active
commonMistake: active 是形容词；修饰动词用 actively，名词为 activity。

example.english: He is active in the school volunteer club.
example.chinese: 他积极参加学校志愿者俱乐部的活动。

application.prompt: Mia takes an ___ part in every community project. A. actively B. active
application.solution: B。解析：名词 part 前需要形容词 active。

grammar: phr. 一起来；跟着来；出现；进展。
collocations: come along with us; come along to the event; things come along
commonMistake: 邀请某人一起参加可说 come along；表示“进展”时常用 how is ... coming along?。

example.english: Would you like to come along to the beach clean-up?
example.chinese: 你愿意一起来参加海滩清洁活动吗？

application.prompt: We are going to visit the shelter. Do you want to ___? A. come along B. come across
application.solution: A。解析：邀请对方一同前往用 come along。

grammar: n. 军队；陆军。
collocations: join the army; an army of volunteers; army service
commonMistake: 表示参军常用 join the army，army 前通常用 the；不要说 join to the army。

example.english: Her grandfather joined the army when he was young.
example.chinese: 她的祖父年轻时参了军。

application.prompt: He decided to ___ after finishing school. A. join to the army B. join the army
application.solution: B。解析：固定搭配为 join the army，不用介词 to。

grammar: n. 军人；士兵。
collocations: an army soldier; a brave soldier; soldiers in uniform
commonMistake: soldier 是可数名词；单数前用 a/an，复数加 -s。

example.english: The soldier helped the family find a safe place.
example.chinese: 那名士兵帮助这家人找到了安全的地方。

application.prompt: A ___ carried the child away from the fire. A. soldier B. soldiers
application.solution: A。解析：冠词 a 后用单数可数名词 soldier。

grammar: adj. 小学教育的；首要的；主要的。
collocations: primary school; primary purpose; primary responsibility
commonMistake: primary school 指小学；primary 也可表示“首要的”，须结合上下文判断。

example.english: My little brother starts primary school next year.
example.chinese: 我弟弟明年开始上小学。

application.prompt: The most important reason is the ___ reason. A. primary B. primarily
application.solution: A。解析：名词 reason 前需要形容词 primary。

grammar: phr. 分担工作；帮忙；帮助摆脱困难。
collocations: help out at a shelter; help sb out with sth; help out a neighbour
commonMistake: help out 可单独使用，也可说 help sb out with sth；代词宾语放 help 与 out 中间。

example.english: My friends helped out at the food bank on Saturday.
example.chinese: 星期六我的朋友们在食品救济站帮忙。

application.prompt: Can you ___ me out with these boxes? A. help B. give
application.solution: A。解析：help sb out with sth 表示帮某人处理某事。

examTags: 词汇·可数与不可数名词
grammar: n. 慈善机构；慈善事业。
collocations: a charity; charity work; give money to charity
commonMistake: charity 指机构时可数；表示慈善事业时常不可数，短语 give to charity 通常不加冠词。

example.english: They raised money for a local children’s charity.
example.chinese: 他们为一家当地儿童慈善机构筹款。

application.prompt: Our class will give the money to a local ___. A. charitable B. charity
application.solution: B。解析：local 后需要名词 charity，表示慈善机构。

grammar: adv. 热情地；温暖地。
collocations: greet sb warmly; welcome sb warmly; smile warmly
commonMistake: warmly 是副词，修饰动词；warm 是形容词，可修饰 clothes、weather 等名词。

example.english: The volunteers warmly welcomed the new members.
example.chinese: 志愿者们热情地欢迎新成员。

application.prompt: The host ___ greeted every visitor at the door. A. warmly B. warm
application.solution: A。解析：修饰动词 greeted 要用副词 warmly。

grammar: n. 女士；淑女。复数 ladies。
collocations: a young lady; ladies and gentlemen; a lady’s bag
commonMistake: lady 的复数是 ladies（辅音字母加 y 结尾变 ies）；lady’s 表示“女士的”。

example.english: A kind lady showed us the way to the station.
example.chinese: 一位好心的女士给我们指了去车站的路。

application.prompt: Two ___ helped carry the boxes upstairs. A. ladys B. ladies
application.solution: B。解析：lady 的正确复数拼写是 ladies。

grammar: n. 先生；君子。复数 gentlemen。
collocations: a kind gentleman; ladies and gentlemen; act like a gentleman
commonMistake: gentleman 的复数是不规则形式 gentlemen，不是 gentlemans。

example.english: The gentleman offered his seat to an elderly passenger.
example.chinese: 这位先生把座位让给了一名年长的乘客。

application.prompt: The two ___ helped an elderly woman with her bags. A. gentlemen B. gentlemans
application.solution: A。解析：gentleman 的复数形式是 gentlemen。

grammar: n. （狗的）吠叫声；v. （狗）吠叫；厉声说。
collocations: a loud bark; bark at a stranger; bark an order
commonMistake: 狗对某人叫用 bark at sb；bark 作名词时表示吠声，也可指树皮，需看语境。

example.english: The dog barked at the postman but did not bite him.
example.chinese: 那只狗冲邮递员吠叫，但没有咬他。

application.prompt: Our dog ___ whenever someone knocks. A. bark B. barks
application.solution: B。解析：主语 our dog 是第三人称单数，谓语用 barks。

grammar: phr. 报名；注册。常用 sign up for sth 或 sign up to do sth。
collocations: sign up for a course; sign up to volunteer; sign up online
commonMistake: 报名参加活动用 sign up for；表示报名去做某事用 sign up to do，不说 sign up doing。

example.english: I signed up for a first-aid course at school.
example.chinese: 我报名参加了学校的急救课程。

application.prompt: Sam wants to ___ for the weekend clean-up. A. sign up B. put up
application.solution: A。解析：报名参加活动用 sign up for。

grammar: phr. 自从；从……以后一直。常与现在完成时连用。
collocations: ever since then; have known sb ever since; ever since I was young
commonMistake: ever since 表示过去某个起点持续到现在，主句常用现在完成时；不是一般过去时的标志。

example.english: She has volunteered at the shelter ever since she was twelve.
example.chinese: 她从十二岁起就一直在收容所做志愿服务。

application.prompt: They have been close friends ___ they met at primary school. A. for B. ever since
application.solution: B。解析：ever since 后接过去起点，主句用现在完成时。

grammar: n. 成年人；adj. 成年的；成熟的。
collocations: an adult; adult education; adult life
commonMistake: adult 作名词时是可数的；单数前用 an，因为 adult 以元音音素开头。

example.english: Children must be with an adult at the swimming pool.
example.chinese: 儿童在游泳池必须有一位成年人陪同。

application.prompt: ___ adult must sign the form. A. An B. A
application.solution: A。解析：adult 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与现在分词
grammar: adj. 失踪的；丢失的；缺少的；也是 miss 的现在分词。
collocations: a missing child; go missing; a page is missing
commonMistake: missing 作形容词表示“失踪、丢失、缺少”；miss sb 表示“想念某人”，不等于 missing person 的词义。

example.english: The police are looking for a missing child.
example.chinese: 警方正在寻找一名失踪儿童。

application.prompt: One page is ___ from this book. A. losing B. missing
application.solution: B。解析：表示书中缺少某页，用 missing。

grammar: adj. 实用的；实际的；切实可行的。
collocations: practical advice; a practical solution; practical experience
commonMistake: practical 是形容词；名词 practice 拼写不同，副词是 practically。

example.english: The guide gives practical advice for helping stray animals.
example.chinese: 这本指南提供了帮助流浪动物的实用建议。

application.prompt: We need a ___ plan that volunteers can follow easily. A. practical B. practice
application.solution: A。解析：名词 plan 前需要形容词 practical。

examTags: 语法·连字符与修饰名词
grammar: adj. 救命的；救生的。常作定语修饰名词。
collocations: life-saving skills; life-saving treatment; a life-saving device
commonMistake: life-saving 作定语时用连字符；life 是名词，saving 在此参与构成形容词。

example.english: The course teaches life-saving skills to teenagers.
example.chinese: 这门课程教青少年救生技能。

application.prompt: Knowing how to give CPR can be a ___ skill. A. save life B. life-saving
application.solution: B。解析：名词 skill 前需要复合形容词 life-saving。

grammar: n. 团队合作。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: good teamwork; teamwork skills; work as a team
commonMistake: teamwork 通常不可数，不加 -s；也可用 work as a team 表达团队合作。

example.english: Good teamwork helped the volunteers finish early.
example.chinese: 良好的团队合作帮助志愿者们提前完成了工作。

application.prompt: The project succeeded because everyone showed great ___. A. teamwork B. teamworks
application.solution: A。解析：teamwork 通常是不可数名词，不加复数 -s。

grammar: adj. 成功的；有成就的。
collocations: a successful event; be successful in doing sth; a successful team
commonMistake: successful 是形容词；名词为 success，副词为 successfully；be successful in 后接名词或动名词。

example.english: The book fair was successful because many students came.
example.chinese: 这次书展很成功，因为有许多学生参加。

application.prompt: The school play was very ___ with both parents and students. A. success B. successful
application.solution: B。解析：very 后接形容词 successful；success 是名词。

grammar: phr. 最重要的是；尤其。用于突出最重要的一点。
collocations: most of all, remember; like sth most of all; what matters most of all
commonMistake: most of all 用来强调“最重要”；most of + 名词表示“大多数……”，结构不同。

example.english: Most of all, we want every child to feel welcome.
example.chinese: 最重要的是，我们希望每个孩子都感到受欢迎。

application.prompt: ___, remember to thank the people who helped you. A. Most of all B. Most of students
application.solution: A。解析：此处要表达“最重要的是”，用 most of all。

grammar: n. 价值；重要作用；v. 重视；珍视。
collocations: the value of teamwork; be of great value; value sb’s help
commonMistake: value 作“价值”时是名词；value sb/sth 作“重视”时是动词，后直接接宾语。

example.english: The volunteers value the trust of the people they help.
example.chinese: 志愿者们珍视他们所帮助的人对自己的信任。

application.prompt: Our club truly ___ the time and effort of all volunteers. A. valuable B. values
application.solution: B。解析：句中需要谓语动词；主语 club 为单数，故用 values。

grammar: adj. 自愿的；无偿的。
collocations: voluntary work; voluntary service; on a voluntary basis
commonMistake: voluntary 是形容词，volunteer 可作名词“志愿者”或动词“自愿做”。

example.english: Voluntary work gives students a chance to help others.
example.chinese: 志愿服务给学生们一个帮助他人的机会。

application.prompt: The students do ___ work at the animal shelter after school. A. voluntary B. volunteer
application.solution: A。解析：名词 work 前需要形容词 voluntary。

grammar: adj. 普通的；平凡的。
collocations: an ordinary day; ordinary people; nothing ordinary
commonMistake: ordinary 修饰名词；副词为 ordinarily；注意不要漏写 -n-。

example.english: An ordinary neighbour can make a big difference by being kind.
example.chinese: 一位普通邻居也能通过善意带来很大影响。

application.prompt: It was just an ___ day until the students began helping others. A. ordinarily B. ordinary
application.solution: B。解析：名词 day 前需要形容词 ordinary。

grammar: adj. 值得；有价值。常用 be worth doing 或 be worth + 金额。
collocations: be worth reading; be worth a visit; worth the effort
commonMistake: worth 后接动名词表示“值得做”；不说 be worth to do。

example.english: The old book is worth reading even today.
example.chinese: 这本旧书即使在今天也值得一读。

application.prompt: The museum is small but it is ___ visiting. A. worth B. worthy to
application.solution: A。解析：固定结构为 be worth doing，故用 worth visiting。

examTags: 语法·集合名词主谓一致
grammar: n. 听众；观众。
collocations: a large audience; audience members; speak to an audience
commonMistake: audience 是集合名词；本题按整体看待时谓语用单数；具体成员可说 audience members。

example.english: The audience listened quietly to the young singer.
example.chinese: 观众们安静地听着这位年轻歌手演唱。

application.prompt: The whole audience ___ loudly after the performance. A. clap B. claps
application.solution: B。解析：whole audience 作为整体看待，谓语用单数 claps。

grammar: adj. 乐意的；愿意的。
collocations: be willing to help; willing volunteers; be willing to learn
commonMistake: willing 后常接不定式 to do；不说 be willing doing。

example.english: Many students are willing to spend their weekends helping others.
example.chinese: 许多学生愿意在周末帮助他人。

application.prompt: Are you ___ to help at the food bank this Saturday? A. willing B. willingly
application.solution: A。解析：be 动词后作表语用形容词 willing，结构为 be willing to do。

grammar: phr. 忙个不停；在活动中；在路上。
collocations: be on the go all day; people on the go; food on the go
commonMistake: on the go 表示持续忙碌或在移动中；不要按字面译成“在去……的路上”而漏掉语境。

example.english: Our volunteers are on the go from morning until night.
example.chinese: 我们的志愿者从早到晚都忙个不停。

application.prompt: The delivery workers are ___ all day, taking meals to families. A. at a loss B. on the go
application.solution: B。解析：全天忙着送餐，符合 on the go（忙个不停）。

grammar: phr. 需要帮助的；生活困难的。常用 people/families in need。
collocations: people in need; help families in need; a friend in need
commonMistake: in need 常放在名词后作后置修饰；表达帮助对象可说 help those in need。

example.english: The group collects warm clothes for families in need.
example.chinese: 这个团体为有需要的家庭收集保暖衣物。

application.prompt: The charity provides meals for people ___. A. in need B. on need
application.solution: A。解析：固定短语为 people in need，表示需要帮助的人。

grammar: adv. 完全地；彻底地。
collocations: completely different; completely understand; completely change
commonMistake: completely 是副词，修饰形容词或动词；形容词是 complete。

example.english: The volunteers completely cleaned the beach before noon.
example.chinese: 志愿者们中午前彻底清理了海滩。

application.prompt: The old playground looks ___ different after the repairs. A. complete B. completely
application.solution: B。解析：修饰形容词 different 需用副词 completely。

examTags: 词汇·可数与不可数名词
grammar: n. 成功；成功的人或事。
collocations: achieve success; a great success; success in doing sth
commonMistake: success 表示抽象的“成功”时通常不可数；表示成功的人或事时可数，如 a success。

example.english: The charity concert was a great success.
example.chinese: 这场慈善音乐会非常成功。

application.prompt: The fundraiser was a great ___. A. success B. successful
application.solution: A。解析：冠词 a 和形容词 great 后需要名词 success。

grammar: adj. （两人中）年纪较长的，尤指兄弟姐妹之间。
collocations: my elder brother; an elder sister; the elder of the two
commonMistake: elder 常用于家庭成员或两者比较，通常不与 than 连用；一般年龄比较用 older than。

example.english: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bike.
example.chinese: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

application.prompt: Tom is my ___ brother, and he is two years older than me. A. elder than B. elder
application.solution: B。解析：在家庭成员称谓前可用 elder；比较结构已由后句表达，不接 than。

grammar: v. 捐赠；赠送。
collocations: donate money to charity; donate blood; donate books
commonMistake: donate 后直接接捐赠物，接受方前用 to；donation 是名词。

example.english: Local businesses donated food to the shelter.
example.chinese: 当地商家向收容所捐赠了食物。

application.prompt: You can ___ old books to the school library. A. donate B. donation
application.solution: A。解析：情态动词 can 后接动词原形 donate。

grammar: n. 衣袋；口袋；小块区域。
collocations: put sth in a pocket; a coat pocket; pocket-sized
commonMistake: pocket 是可数名词；表示某件衣服上的口袋常用 a pocket，不能漏掉冠词。

example.english: He put the note in his coat pocket.
example.chinese: 他把纸条放进了外套口袋。

application.prompt: She found a small card in the ___ of her jacket. A. packet B. pocket
application.solution: B。解析：夹克上的口袋是 pocket；packet 表示小包。

grammar: n. 零花钱。money 不可数。
collocations: get pocket money; save pocket money; spend pocket money on
commonMistake: pocket money 中 money 不可数，不加复数 -s；表示金额可用 some/a little pocket money。

example.english: I save some pocket money to buy books for the children.
example.chinese: 我存下一些零花钱，给孩子们买书。

application.prompt: Leo uses his ___ to buy a birthday card for his friend. A. pocket money B. pocket moneys
application.solution: A。解析：money 不可数，pocket money 不加 -s。

examTags: 词汇·可数与不可数名词
grammar: n. 努力；艰难的尝试。
collocations: make an effort; put effort into sth; make every effort to do
commonMistake: 常说 make an effort to do sth；effort 作“努力”时可数或不可数，按语境使用冠词。

example.english: With a little effort, everyone can keep the park clean.
example.chinese: 只要稍微努力一下，每个人都能保持公园清洁。

application.prompt: We should make an ___ to include every new student. A. effect B. effort
application.solution: B。解析：make an effort 是固定搭配，表示“作出努力”。

grammar: phr. 分发；散发。
collocations: hand out leaflets; hand sth out to sb; hand out food
commonMistake: hand out 可分开：hand out the forms/hand the forms out；代词宾语必须放中间。

example.english: The volunteers handed out water to runners after the race.
example.chinese: 比赛结束后，志愿者们给跑步者分发饮用水。

application.prompt: Please ___ these information sheets to the visitors. A. hand out B. look after
application.solution: A。解析：向来访者分发资料用 hand out。

grammar: phr. 熟悉；通晓。常用 be familiar with sth/sb。
collocations: be familiar with the rules; become familiar with; quite familiar with
commonMistake: be familiar with 表示“某人熟悉某物”；be familiar to 表示“某物为某人所熟悉”。

example.english: The new volunteer is familiar with the safety rules.
example.chinese: 这位新志愿者熟悉安全规定。

application.prompt: I am not ___ this computer program, so please show me how to use it. A. similar to B. familiar with
application.solution: B。解析：表示“熟悉某程序”用 be familiar with。

grammar: adv. 等等；以及诸如此类。是 et cetera 的缩写。
collocations: books, clothes, etc.; food, water, etc.; and so on
commonMistake: etc. 用于列举末尾，前面通常用逗号；避免写 and etc.，因为 etc. 本身已有“等等”之意。

example.english: The centre needs books, toys, clothes, etc.
example.chinese: 中心需要书籍、玩具、衣物等物品。

application.prompt: We collected blankets, food, and ___ for the shelter. A. etc. B. et cetera things
application.solution: A。解析：列举末尾可用 etc.；不需要再加 and。

grammar: n. 才能；天赋；有才能的人。
collocations: have a talent for music; show a talent; a talented artist
commonMistake: 表示在某方面有天赋用 have a talent for sth/doing；形容词是 talented。

example.english: Nina has a talent for making everyone feel welcome.
example.chinese: 妮娜很有天赋，总能让每个人感到受欢迎。

application.prompt: He has a natural ___ for working with animals. A. talented B. talent
application.solution: B。解析：形容词 natural 后需要名词 talent。

grammar: n. （正式、礼貌的称呼）女士；夫人。也可作信件称呼。
collocations: Dear Madam; excuse me, madam; ladies and gentlemen
commonMistake: madam 用于正式称呼女性；一般日常交流中可用 ma’am（美式口语）或称呼姓名。

example.english: The shop assistant asked, “May I help you, madam?”
example.chinese: 店员问道：“女士，需要帮忙吗？”

application.prompt: At the start of a formal letter to an unknown woman, you may write “Dear ___”. A. Madam B. Mrs
application.solution: A。解析：收信人姓名和婚姻状况未知时，正式称呼可用 Dear Madam。

grammar: n. 广告；启事。常缩写为 ad。
collocations: an advertisement for a job; put an advertisement in a paper; TV advertisement
commonMistake: advertisement 是可数名词，单数前用 an；动词为 advertise，缩写 ad 也常见。

example.english: I saw an advertisement for a weekend volunteer event.
example.chinese: 我看到一则周末志愿活动的广告。

application.prompt: The school posted an ___ for new volunteers. A. advertise B. advertisement
application.solution: B。解析：an 后需要名词 advertisement。
